cloistersword.name: Cloistersword
cloistersword.desc: A brother-blade of the Gray Cloister, ground thin by a hundred years of vigils. The fuller is engraved: 'wake, watch, wait'.

sexton_maul.name: Sexton's Maul
sexton_maul.desc: The gravedigger's hammer, meant for fence posts and frost-hard earth. It has learned other work since.

ward_halberd.name: Ward's Halberd
ward_halberd.desc: Issued to the Cloister Wards for the watching of walls. The haft is worn where a gauntlet gripped it for forty years.

marsh_spear.name: Fen-Ward Spear
marsh_spear.desc: A marsh patrol pike, ash-hafted and leaf-headed. The reach kept the wards out of the water and the water out of the wards. Two hands; the haft turns a blow, but it is no shield.

pilgrim_greatsword.name: Pilgrim's Greatsword
pilgrim_greatsword.desc: A slab of relic-iron carried a hundred leagues on a penitent's back. Slow as absolution and about as final. The flat turns blows better than a spear-haft, worse than a shield.

lark_bow.name: Larkbow
lark_bow.desc: A birdkeeper's recurve of pale ash, strung for retrieving escaped songbirds unharmed. Draws quiet, looses sharp. Feed it arrows; it gives no guard in return.

torch.name: Pilgrim's Torch
torch.desc: A wax-soaked brand from the First Wick's own dipping vat. It holds the dark at arm's length, and little else.
